name: mod-heads-up
description: While Claude works, a side check now and then flags one thing you should understand and probably missed: a card above the prompt, and a Heads up panel with every note of the session by turn

enabled.title: Check while Claude works
enabled.description: Every sixth step of a turn, at most once per turn, a side check reads the session and flags one thing worth knowing. Off, no request is made

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait and hover colors fade. Off, everything draws still

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
